name: Deliah's Ring
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Deliah's Ring lies among the Rot Hide gnolls’ corpse piles. Its inscription points back to a plague victim taken from Tirisfal’s mass graves.

sections.title: A Keepsake in the Mire
sections.body: Among the Rot Hide gnoll mounds in Silverpine Forest, a ring rests on the hand of a fairly fresh corpse. The band bears a simple inscription: “For Deliah.” The gnolls do more than scavenge battlefields. They raid the mass graves of Tirisfal Glades and carry human and Forsaken corpses south to Fenris Isle for their own purposes.

sections.title: Ties to Brill
sections.body: High Executor Hadrec sends the ring to Brill, where Magistrate Sevren keeps records of the recently deceased. Sevren confirms that Deliah lived in Brill and died of the plague. She was buried before body-snatchers exhumed her remains. The ring leads to the grief of those she left behind, and to the question of whether mortal devotion can endure undeath.

aliases: how do you get deliahs ring
faq.answer: Deliah's Ring lies on the hand of a plague victim among the Rot Hide gnoll mounds in northern Silverpine Forest. The dead there have been scavenged and left unwrapped.
Deliah lived in Brill and died of the plague. She was buried in the local mass graves before Rot Hide gnolls stole her body and dragged it into Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why did the Rot Hide gnolls have her body?
aliases: what are gnolls doing with corpses
faq.answer: The Rot Hide gnolls are aligned with the Scourge and pillage the communal graves in Tirisfal Glades. They stockpile corpses and carry them toward their stronghold on Fenris Isle.

faq.q: What is the inscription on the ring?
faq.answer: The ring bears the words “For Deliah” inside its band. A lover or husband gave it to her before she died.

angles.text: As an undead, you know mortal attachments can fade alongside the flesh. A rare few still hold to the memory of those they loved in life.
